notes.title: Dr. Kinderwood's Asylum - Demo Available!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce Dr. Kinderwood's Asylum demo!

[h2]Demo Gameplay Trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=_8RwWD9FZr4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Demo-1.0 features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Spend the first three days in the infirmary: get to know its inhabitants or focus on finding a cure.
[*] Point-and-click movement between locations and interaction with items.
[*] Illuminate active areas for interaction.
[*] Accept the consequences of the result of your active actions with a mini-game.
[*] Character Relationships.
[*] The plot is constantly moving forward.
[*] No music (work in progress, will be added later in an update to the demo).
[/list]

[h3]Translations (demo version)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Original game language: Russian.
[*] Edited English translation.
[*] MTL translation into other languages.
[/list]
[i]You can help us improve the translation by clicking the copy text button in the game and sending a report to our Discord server.[/i]

Please leave your reviews and feedback in this chat. What did you like? What was strange or disliked? What would you like to see in the game? Share your thoughts. It will help us make the game better.
